description: This file defines the RedirectMiddleware class for handling HTTP redirect logic within the Guzzle HTTP client library. It manages redirect behaviors, tracks redirect history, and enforces redirect limits.

classes.name: GuzzleHttp\RedirectMiddleware
classes.description: A middleware class for handling HTTP redirects in Guzzle, managing redirect logic, history tracking, and limiting redirect counts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, applying redirect logic if allowed via options.

methods.name: checkRedirect
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates a redirect and handles the redirect process.

methods.name: withTracking
methods.description: Adds redirect history headers to the response for tracking purposes.

methods.name: guardMax
methods.description: Checks and enforces the maximum number of redirects allowed, throwing an exception if exceeded.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the request for redirect, including changing the method, URI, headers, and handling cross-origin requests.

methods.name: redirectUri
methods.description: Resolves the redirect Location header into a URI object and validates the protocol.
